text:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary alert: model-serving v2.3.1 showing 5xx spike in eu-west1 at 10% traffic. Error rate 4.8% (baseline 0.1%). Suggested rollout image: eu-images/model-serving:2.3.1-hotfix. Requesting expedited pin/fastpath. Link: https://ci/reports/1799990001
Ashley: ugh, noticed increased 5xxs on dashboards too. Is this the tokenizer header bug?
Kevin: yes, root cause looks like header parsing under long-inputs. Patch is a one-line fix in token-mapper; unit + smoke pass locally.
DevOps-Jen: can we just rollback to 2.3.0? Revert avoids patch risk.
Kevin: rollback will reintroduce incorrect token truncation for long prompts; a bunch of customers already hit it. Hotfix is safer if we can fast-verify.
SRE-Mike: requirements to skip regular canary: 1) 2 approvers from eng/release, 2) staging smoke run + nightwatch e2e, 3) on-call readiness and revert command posted.
Ashley: I can approve and run smoke.
Nina: I approve. I'll watch metrics.
Kevin: thanks. Proposed rollout: pinned deploy with staged ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m windows, automatic rollback threshold: 2% error-rate or latency p95 > 600ms.
DevOps-Jen: +1 to thresholds. Who triggers the initial pin?
Ashley: I'll trigger if release-bot shows green for smoke.
release-bot: [release-bot] Smoke tests: staging-smoke-suite passed (12/12). Nightwatch e2e queued (ETA ~6m).
Kevin: nightwatch passed locally, but wait for the run.
release-bot: [release-bot] Nightwatch e2e: all checks passed.
SRE-Mike: good. Post the rollback command here and the release note blurb.
Kevin: Rollout command:
```
deployctl roll --svc=model-serving --image=eu-images/model-serving:2.3.1-hotfix --stages=5,25,100 --interval=900 --auto-rollback-error=2% --auto-rollback-p95=600ms --pin
```
Kevin: Rollback command:
```
deployctl rollback --svc=model-serving --to-image=eu-images/model-serving:2.3.0 --force-redeploy
```
Kevin: Release note (short): "Fix header token mapping causing 5xx on long inputs. Improves stability for long-context prompts. No schema changes."
Ashley: +1 to deploy now. I'm on standby to run smoke and watch logs.
Nina: monitoring dashboards pinned, will alert on PagerDuty if thresholds hit.
DevOps-Jen: I'll hold the release window open for 45m and coordinate routing.
SRE-Mike: approved. Two approvers present (Ashley, Nina).
Ashley: executing deploy now.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Rollout started by Ashley. Stage 1: 5% traffic. Image: eu-images/model-serving:2.3.1-hotfix. Link: https://ci/deploys/1799990001
Ashley: running quick smoke...
release-bot: [release-bot] smoke-check: OK. Short-run inference tests passed.
Nina: metrics look clean so far (error-rate 0.08%, p95 210ms).
DevOps-Jen: moving to 25% in 2m.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 scheduled in 120s.
Kevin: watching logs for header exceptions.
SRE-Mike: if anything >1% error or sustained p95 >500ms we abort and rollback.
Ashley: noted.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 started: 25% traffic.
Nina: still stable. Error-rate 0.12%.
release-bot: posting release note to changelog: "model-serving: v2.3.1-hotfix \u2014 header token mapping fix (staged rollout)"
DevOps-Jen: good. Schedule full 100% in 15m unless we see noise.
Kevin: thanks everyone. If we need to rollback, run the rollback command above and ping #incidents.
Ashley: final: full rollout is green, moving to 100%.
deploy-bot: Stage 3 started: 100% traffic. Rollout complete. No auto-rollback triggered.
Nina: monitoring for 30m post-deploy. All clear so far.
SRE-Mike: closing fastpath window. Please attach follow-up postmortem if any customer reports.
Ashley: will add a short note to the release ticket with logs and approvals. :thumbsup:
